2608.28478.title: Blind Men and the Elephant: Probing the Epistemic Myopia of LLMs under Long-Tail Divergent Knowledge
2608.28478.paper_summary: Factual question answering (QA) typically assumes a single canonical answer, obscuring whether large language models (LLMs) retain divergent accounts of long-tail facts. To address this gap, we introduce ElephantBench, a closed-book knowledge probe comprising 1,094 questions generated through an auditable graph-based pipeline. The pipeline retrieves related documents from a low-exposure web corpus, identifies naturally occurring disagreements, and converts them into multi-account QA records. Each answer is verified against the originating documents and authoritative public web sources and is then reviewed by human annotators. Across 32 models, even the strongest model recovers both accounts on only 52.4% of questions, while on nearly all remaining questions it recalls one account but omits the other. Scaling model size and inference-time reasoning improve recall but do not eliminate this incompleteness. Corpus analysis further shows that exposure imbalance favors the dominant account, whereas greater minority-side exposure is associated with more complete recall. These findings establish ElephantBench as a reproducible knowledge probe for diagnosing epistemic myopia in parametric memory. More broadly, our graph-based benchmark construction pipeline provides an efficient and scalable way to turn long-tail corpora into source-traceable knowledge probes, supporting efforts to evaluate and advance the epistemic rigour of next-generation LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/ElephantBench.
2608.28478.paper_summary_zh: 事實問題回答（QA）通常假設存在單一的典範答案，這掩蓋了大型語言模型（LLMs）是否保留了長尾事實的不同解釋。為了解決這一空白，我們引入了 ElephantBench，一個由 1,094 個問題組成的閉卷知識探測工具，這些問題是通過可審計的基於圖形的流程生成的。該流程從低曝光的網絡語料庫中檢索相關文檔，識別自然發生的分歧，並將其轉換為多賬戶 QA 記錄。每個答案都會根據原始文檔和權威的公共網絡來源進行驗證，然後由人工標註者進行審查。在 32 個模型中，即使是最強的模型也僅在 52.4% 的問題上恢復了兩種解釋，而在幾乎所有剩餘問題上，它回憶起一種解釋但忽略了另一種。擴大模型大小和推理時間的推理提高了回憶率，但並未消除這種不完整性。語料庫分析進一步顯示，曝光不平衡有利於主導解釋，而較大的少數方曝光則與更完整的回憶相關。這些發現確立了 ElephantBench 作為一個可重複的知識探測工具，用於診斷參數記憶中的認識近視。更廣泛地說，我們的基於圖形的基準構建流程提供了一種高效且可擴展的方式，將長尾語料庫轉化為可追溯來源的知識探測工具，支持評估和推進下一代 LLM 的認識嚴謹性。代碼可在 https://github.com/Tencent/ElephantBench 獲得。
